places.title: Victoria Memorial
places.description: Iconic marble building dedicated to Queen Victoria, surrounded by expansive gardens and lush green lawns.

places.title: Indian Museum
places.description: The oldest and largest multi-purpose museum in the Asia-Pacific region, housing rare antiques, mummies, and armor.

places.title: Howrah Bridge & Flower Market
places.description: Famous cantilever bridge spanning the Hooghly river alongside the colorful Mullick Ghat Flower Market.

places.title: Birla Planetarium
places.description: Single-storied circular structure designed in the Buddhist Stupa style featuring daily astronomy shows.

places.title: Park Street Culinary Walk & Peter Cat
places.description: Legendary street famed for iconic Chelo Kebabs, heritage cafes, and Kolkata street food delights.

places.title: Dakshineswar Kali Temple & Belur Math
places.description: Spiritual center on the banks of Hooghly River founded by Rani Rashmoni, connected to Ramakrishna Paramahamsa.

places.title: Science City Kolkata
places.description: Largest science center in the Indian subcontinent featuring space theater, 3D digital shows, and time ride.

places.title: Marble Palace Mansion
places.description: Palatial 19th-century mansion built with ninety-six types of marble, housing classical European sculptures.

places.title: Eco Tourism Park
places.description: Sprawling urban park with replica 7 Wonders of the World, boating lake, and ecological zones.

places.title: Academy of Fine Arts & Nandan
places.description: Cultural hub of Kolkata hosting theatrical performances, art exhibitions, and film screenings.

rag_context: Victoria Memorial entry tickets cost ₹50 for Indian nationals. The gardens are open early at 5:30 AM for morning walkers.
Indian Museum is located right next to Park Street Metro, ideal indoor shelter during monsoon rainstorms.
Park Street is Kolkata's premier culinary avenue with famous heritage restaurants like Peter Cat, Flurys, and Mocambo.
Howrah Bridge gets heavy traffic between 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM. Metro transit via Green Line under river is recommended.
Dakshineswar Kali Temple closes its main sanctum between 12:30 PM and 3:30 PM.

places.title: Eiffel Tower
places.description: Iconic wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars, offering panoramic views of Paris.

places.title: Louvre Museum
places.description: The world's largest art museum and historic monument housing the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.

places.title: Musée d'Orsay
places.description: Housed in a grand Beaux-Arts railway station featuring Impressionist masterpieces by Monet and Van Gogh.

places.title: Sainte-Chapelle & Conciergerie
places.description: Royal chapel in Gothic style with breathtaking 13th-century stained glass windows.

rag_context: The Louvre Museum requires timed entry reservations in advance. Tuesday is closed day.
The Eiffel Tower summit elevator can be paused during strong winds or rain.
Musée d'Orsay offers free audio guides with masterworks breakdown.

places.title: Senso-ji Temple
places.description: Tokyo's oldest and most significant Buddhist temple located in Asakusa with Nakamise shopping street.

places.title: teamLab Planets
places.description: Immersive body-on digital art museum where visitors walk through water and light installations.

places.title: Meiji Jingu Shrine & Yoyogi Park
places.description: Serene Shinto shrine surrounded by 170 acres of evergreen forest in the heart of Harajuku.

rag_context: teamLab Planets requires barefoot entry; water levels reach knee-high in certain art rooms.
Senso-ji Nakamise stalls close around 6:00 PM, though the temple grounds stay lit at night.
Suica/Pasmo IC cards make Tokyo subway navigation instant.
